nb_confirm_big.message:
⚠ $1 at once is a lot.

Instagram restricts accounts for this, and Ghoosted cannot prevent it: going slowly helps, it doesn't make you invisible.

Safer: no more than $2 a day, and don't repeat it several days running.

Continue anyway?

req_confirm.message:
Approve the pending requests?

Ghoosted approves up to 20 per pass, with pauses. Even so, approving many at once is one of the things Instagram watches most closely — along with mass unfollowing.

If you got an "automated behaviour" warning recently, leave this alone for a few days.

Continue?

req_auto_warn.message:
AUTOMATIC APPROVAL

Ghoosted will approve requests on its own, while you're doing something else.

The risk: Instagram restricts accounts for approving in bulk. Along with mass unfollowing, it's what they watch most. Ghoosted approves at most 20 per pass, with pauses — that lowers the risk, it doesn't remove it.

req_auto_warn_all.message: And with "Everyone": anyone who asks gets into your private account, without you looking at who they are.

req_auto_warn_end.message:
You can switch back to Manual whenever you want.

Turn it on, accepting the risk?
